description: Find scans that look like this one by screenshot similarity, favicon or fuzzy page hash (methods, default screenshot), each with URL, final URL, title and what it matched by; paginated. Useful for finding copies of a phishing page on other hosts. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

methods.description: Similarity methods to use: screenshot (default), favicon and fuzzy (page content hash).
methods.title: Methods

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
scan_id.title: Scan Id
